name: auth-verify-route
title: Fix account verification REST route
description: Move POST /api/auth/verify-account into the auth route boundary so email verification links do not return Route not found.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Root cause: the account verification REST endpoint is an auth route, but it was registered inside the upload plugin. The frontend posts /api/auth/verify-account from VerifyAccountConfirm; when the plugin route is unavailable or stale, Fastify falls through to Route not found. Register the endpoint directly with the other auth REST routes and keep upload.route.js upload/chatbot focused.
